procedure_text: 环磺酮的制备是通过2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酸与氯化亚砜反应生成2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯
procedure_summary: The substituted benzoic acid is reacted with thionyl chloride to give the corresponding benzoyl chloride.
notes: First of the three transformations named in the single sentence at [0009], line 95, which states the whole route in one sentence. procedure_text is that sentence's first clause verbatim; the sentence is not divisible into three self-contained statements, so Step 1 to Step 3 share one source sentence and each carries its own clause. reaction_class is nucleophilic_substitution because the reaction substitutes chloride for hydroxyl at the carboxyl carbon. acylation and halogenation are both defensible for the same transformation, so reaction_class_confidence is medium; the reference run never annotates this step, so there is no precedent to follow. named_reaction is null: no widely accepted name applies. This section states no charge, no temperature, no time, no pressure and no yield anywhere, so scale is not_specified, every quantity field is null and no_conditions is raised. Whether this route is prior art or the invention's own is not settled by this section; the flag for that sits on the two records from the [0010] drawing, and the same uncertainty applies to this prose record. procedure_text: 再与环己二酮反应生成烯醇酯
procedure_summary: The benzoyl chloride is reacted with cyclohexanedione to give the enol ester.
notes: Second transformation of the [0009] sentence, line 95. reaction_class is ester_formation because the acyl chloride acylates the enol oxygen of the dione to give an O-acyl enol ester. linkage_confirmed is true on two independent grounds: the product identifier of Step 1 is a reactant identifier here, and the clause opens with 再与, an explicit back-reference to the compound the previous clause produced. The locant on the dione is a real gap in this section and is recorded, not fixed: [0009] names it as plain 环己二酮 with no locant, which on this section's prose alone leaves the 1,2, 1,3 and 1,4 isomers open. The locant is fixed by the document itself and not by outside knowledge, the [0010] drawing drawing the 1,3-dione and [0029] and [0053] printing the 1,3 locant explicitly, and A1 resolved it to cyclohexane-1,3-dione on that evidence. This record uses A1's identifier so the two artifacts join, and states here that this section alone does not carry the locant. The product is never named in full anywhere in the document: [0009] calls it only 烯醇酯, a class phrase, and A1 carries it as an unresolved functional_ref whose structure is known from the drawing alone. This section states no charge, no temperature, no time, no pressure and no yield anywhere, so scale is not_specified, every quantity field is null and no_conditions is raised. safety_notes: The tembotrione product of this rearrangement is stated to be contaminated with residual cyanide impurities, and the patent says a positive Ames mutagenicity result can be obtained on the contaminant.
The patent states that the positive Ames result is not an intrinsic property of tembotrione but a result produced by the residual cyanide impurities.
procedure_text: 经过丙酮氰醇重排反应最终生成环磺酮(tembotrione)。 上述经过重排过程生成的生成环磺酮产品，通常会生成催化剂丙酮氰醇以及反应氰化物杂质污染，经过污染物致突变性检测(Ames)能得到正的Ames测试实验结果，但这并不是其固有性质，是残留的氰化物杂质所产生的结果。
procedure_summary: The enol ester undergoes an acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement to give tembotrione, which is stated to be contaminated with residual cyanide impurities.
notes: Third and last transformation of the [0009] sentence, line 95, extended by [0011], which comments on this same step's product. procedure_text is the [0009] clause followed by the whole of [0011]; [0011] straddles a page break, beginning at line 100 and continuing at line 105 with no marker reprinted, and the two halves are joined here as one sentence. reaction_class is acylation because the transformation converts an O-acyl enol ester into a C-acyl 2-aroyl-1,3-dione. The reference run is not settled on this: it calls the same transformation acylation twice and other once, so reaction_class_confidence is medium. named_reaction is null even though the patent prints its own name for it, 丙酮氰醇重排反应, an acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement, because that is not a widely accepted named reaction and rule 19 forbids stretching for one; the patent's own name is recorded here instead, and transformation:rearrangement is tagged alongside transformation:acylation. acetone cyanohydrin is role catalyst on the patent's own word: [0011] line 100 calls it 催化剂丙酮氰醇, the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin. Mechanistically it acts as the cyanide source, which is what makes the residual cyanide of [0011] a consequence of this step and not of any other. cyanide is carried as a by_product because [0011] says the rearrangement produces cyanide impurity contamination alongside the product; it is the substance the whole patent exists to remove. It is unresolved in A1 as a class, the document never saying which cyanide species. Two oddities in [0011] are recorded and not repaired. The Chinese prints 生成 twice, reading 生成的生成环磺酮产品, and it says the process 生成 (produces) the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin, which reads oddly for a catalyst; both are recorded as printed. byproduct_recovery stays null because [0011] describes contamination, not recovery or reuse.
